summary_en: 770,000 shares (2.42% of shares outstanding ex-treasury); ¥1.5B upper limit; acquisition period Aug 6 to Oct 30, 2026; method: open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange; stated rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency under medium-term plan (2025–2027).
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: On 5 August 2026, Ryobi Limited's board resolved to acquire up to 770,000 of its own ordinary shares for an aggregate amount not to exceed ¥1.5 billion during the period 6 August to 30 October 2026. The shares will be acquired via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The 770,000-share target represents 2.42% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), calculated against the 31,809,471 shares outstanding as of 30 June 2026. The company states the buyback is undertaken to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under its medium-term management plan (fiscal 2025–2027), announced 13 February 2025. The announcement notes this buyback is coordinated with a concurrent increase in the final dividend guidance.
